notes.title: White screen Hajji VR bug
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone ! 

Thank you all for purchasing Hajji VR and Hajji Tours !
Just to let you guys know we are aware about a bug in the VR version.
Some of you cannot load a map and you get stuck in a white screen (map transition) we are troubleshooting this and we will patch that asap !

Be sure that you guys met the minimum requirement for this VR version. Sometime it can take a little will depending of your PC configuration.

Thank you for your patience !

notes.title: Beta 1.0 version !
notes.notes:
Hey,

Hajji VR is now in Beta 1.0.
What does it mean exactly ? Well we removed the internal patcher as the game is now stable and we don't need to do daily update on it.
We've also prepared some "stuff" for the Mecca map and the "teaching mode" including our AI's.

We are super excited to show you soon our work = D 

Visit our discord for more informations : 
https://discord.gg/3Fj4HSDa68
